## QA Run 36 — Frontend Sweep Result

**Verdict: clean. 0 defects found. 0 commits made.**

### Pages tested (all rendered, 0 console errors)
- `/dashboard`, `/pipeline`, `/leads`, `/leads/:id`, `/estimates`, `/invoices`, `/work-orders`, `/tasks`, `/calendar`, `/reports`, `/canvassing`, `/storm-map`, `/storm-catalog`, `/contracts`, `/expenses`, `/materials`, `/subcontractors`
- `/settings` — all **14 tabs** click through cleanly: Profile, Company, Billing, Payments, Team, Storm Alerts, Notifications, Email/SMTP, Financing, Automations, Drip Sequences, Custom Fields, Pricing/Line Items, Reviews

### Brief-vs-codebase drift (noted, not bugs)
- `/content-studio` listed in the brief **does not exist** in the codebase — no component, no route.
- Brief said "Storm Archive at `/storm-archive`" — real route is `/storm-catalog`. Both labels and the sidebar nav work.

### Auth note for next run
`VITE_DEV_BYPASS_AUTH=true` makes the UI render without a JWT, so every page fires 3× 401s until you set `localStorage.token` manually via the `/api/auth/login` POST. Any QA run that skips this step will falsely flag every page as broken.

### Pre-existing in-flight work
The pagination fix for Carry-over #12 (14 endpoints 5xx on negative `?limit=-1`) is fully implemented in the working tree from a prior run — `server/src/utils/pagination.js` + 11 route files. **Not committed by this run** (out of scope: this run was frontend-only). Next backend run should re-run `.qa-pagination-probe.mjs` to verify and commit.

Resume file at `memory/overnight_resume.md` updated with full Run 36 notes.
